name: Romania: Part II package and CTIS upload check
applies_to: the Romania package as a whole (plan-level checklist step)

items.check: K1 recruitment and informed-consent procedure present, on EudraLex template v2.0 for new submissions since 1 September 2026 (current ANMDMR form checked), with a section for every population pathway in the plan.
K2 recruitment material in Romanian for every recruitment tool; prior CNBMDM approval planned for electronic resources.
One L1 information and consent set per population in population_sets whose trigger is true, plus translated sets for planned non-Romanian-speaking populations.

For every Romanian site: M1 CV and M2 declaration of interests on the current national forms, signed where required; N1 site suitability on the national form signed by the principal investigator, head of department and institution manager.
ANMDMR authorisation of each Phase I or bioequivalence unit.
O1 insurance or indemnity evidence covering trial-related injury or death.
P1 national compensation form present, stating explicitly when no payment is offered.
P2 description of trial financing and the unsigned sponsor-site or sponsor-investigator contract with the general payment clauses.
R1 data-protection declaration under Annex I section R.
S1 biological-samples information (EU form or the non-mandatory Order 3390/2022 template), consistent with the protocol, participant information and any secondary-use document.
Romanian payment commitment form for ANMDMR invoices in the CTIS Forms section, checked against the current ANMDMR pages.
Sites and principal investigators in CTIS match the M and N documents; a paediatrician is on the investigator team where minors are included.
Every participant- or representative-facing document, including recruitment material, is in Romanian.
Non-participant documents are in Romanian or English.
Participant ICFs submitted blank; consent signatures are not confused with submission signatures.
Investigator and site forms with signature fields signed before submission where the current national form requires it; the P2 contract unsigned.
Non-Romanian-speaking enrolment: translated documents and the K1 explanation of valid consent included.
Compensation amounts, conditions and recipients identical in P1 and every participant document; any cross-reference exact.
Insurance and injury pathway identical in O1 and every participant document.
Sample types, coding, storage, access, transfers and retention identical in S1, the protocol and the participant documents.
Data flows, recipients, transfers and retention identical in R1, the participant documents and the protocol.
Consent pathways and signature rules in K1 match the L1 sets in the package.
Documents adapted from the reference package contain all Romanian national additions and no leftovers from the reference country.
items.applies_when: Romania is not the reference package

items.check: Correct B–S section prefix and CTIS placeholder for each document; proof of payment in the CTIS Forms section.
Unique, self-explanatory title of at most 100 characters: <section code>_<document type>_<subtype>_<country>_<language>_<special attribute>, with only the fields that distinguish the document.
Version and date entered in CTIS metadata, not in the title.
Personal names only where disclosure permits (principal investigator in M1/M2).
Clean, tracked-change, redacted or public and split-file variants clearly distinguished.
Uploaded filename base contains none of ( ) / , . ; | [ ] (the period before the extension is fine).
Article 11 workaround: every mandatory Part II placeholder holds the official placeholder PDF titled Part_II_placeholder_document_Article_11_workaround.
items.applies_when: Romania receives Part I only under Article 11

items.check: For each document, publication status checked against the current Annex I publication tables (revised CTIS transparency rules from 18 June 2024; ACT EU guidance v2.2, 30 April 2026).
Publishable documents: personal data and qualifying CCI redacted in a public version; the complete version kept for assessment where required.
No personal data or CCI in public structured fields.
No drafting instruction remains in any document (see content/conventions/template-instructions.md).
No tracked changes, hidden comments or placeholder text in any document.
Every document approved by the owner in TrialAgents, or the user has explicitly chosen to export unapproved versions.
